name: FileDrop
description:
Drop files on the dashed tile, or activate it to browse. The file input itself is the
focusable control (so a Field label names it and Enter/Space open the picker); the
tile shows its focus. Rejected files are reported to `onFiles` with a reason for the
field's message line — the tile never grows to show errors.
signature: ({ onFiles, accept, maxSize, maxFiles, existing, multiple, disabled, invalid, hint, dragging: forceDragging, variant, className, "aria-label": ariaLabel, }: FileDropProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no Field label names it (a Field label is preferred).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: dragging
props.description: Show the drag-over state without a drag (documentation and tests).

props.name: existing
props.description: Files already in the list (for maxFiles).

props.name: hint
props.description: The limits line. Default: built from maxSize and accept ("Max 500 MB per file · .msi or .exe").

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows more than one selected value.

props.name: onFiles
props.description: Called with the files that fit the limits and the ones that do not (with reasons).

props.name: variant
props.description: full: the dashed tile. compact: one control-height row for toolbars and table rows.
